scientific_scope_status: For supplied tails f_R(r)=C r^-2(ln r)^-p[1+d/ln r+o(1/ln r)], p>1, the internally reviewed proof derives actual quantum heated entropy defect through its second term and an eventual positive two-port amplifier gap after leading cancellation, despite no finite photon moment above one. A separate cold-reviewed extension covers positive C2 nonincreasing integrable log envelopes under stated derivative and density-error bounds, including 1/[r^2 ln r(ln ln r)^q], q>1, and noncomparable input envelopes. Actual added heat, fixed sources/gain and supplied tail hypotheses are essential. Heat threshold is source-dependent. General unheated finite-energy amplifier conjecture, useful uniform threshold, efficient physical process and acquisition remain open; shared-temperature multimode extensions are separate.
